description: Extract dated events from pasted syllabus text. Each line that names a date becomes one event, with a title, a type, a date and optional times. Inputs: text (the pasted syllabus or course schedule, one event per line), course (a course name or code to put on every event) and year (the year to use when a date has no year). Titles are read from the words around the date, and each event is marked as an assignment, exam, quiz, lab, reading, class or other. Any line that has no date is returned in undated_lines instead of being dropped silently. The answer ends with a next step hint that points to build_ics when the events should become a calendar. Example prompt: "Turn this syllabus into calendar events: Assignment 1 due Sep 15, Midterm exam October 20 at 10:00."

course.description: Course name or code to put on every event, such as BIO 101.

text.description: The pasted syllabus or course schedule. Put one event on each line, with a date on the line.

year.description: The year to use when a date has no year. Defaults to the current year.

name: extract_schedule_events

events.description: Every dated event that was found, in date order.

course.description: Course name or code, or null when the event has none.

date.description: Date of the event as YYYY-MM-DD.

end_time.description: End time as HH:MM, or null when the event has no end time.

location.description: Room or place, or null when the event has none.

notes.description: Extra notes, or null when the event has none.

start_time.description: Start time as HH:MM, or null for an all day event.

type.description: The kind of event: assignment, exam, quiz, lab, reading, class or other.

next_step.description: Suggested next tool call for turning the events into a calendar.

undated_lines.description: Lines that had no date, kept in the order they appeared so they can be fixed.

year.description: The year used for dates that did not name one.

title: Extract schedule events
